description: Dev-only: lets the webview forward console.* output and observed IPC traffic to the MCP bridge's ring buffers, so query_logs and manage_ipc can see them. Kept in its own file rather than merged into default.json because the whole bridge is a development tool - deleting this file is how you turn the webview half off. Tauri capabilities cannot be gated on build profile, so this grant exists in every build; it is inert unless the bridge is actually compiled in, because attach_mcp_bridge() registers the plugin only under the non-default 'mcp' cargo feature (see the #[cfg(feature = "mcp")] gate in lib.rs) - without that feature mcp.push_log/push_ipc are commands that simply do not exist. No workflow builds with --features mcp, so it does not ship.
